units.function: Seventeen-file recovery subsystem that classifies stranded work and issue-graph liveness, retries or escalates assignment/continuation/review failures, watches silent active runs, creates source-scoped recovery actions, schedules provider-quota waits, repairs dependency wakes, and terminalizes orphaned runs/stale issue locks.
units.dependencyDirection: Pure policy helpers import shared types, but the 5,813-line service directly imports Drizzle schema, budgets, issues, execution policy, activity log, process supervisor, run-log storage, settings, redaction and Heartbeat enqueueWakeup. Recovery is therefore an orchestration monolith coupled to Paperclip issue/run/Agent storage and local process semantics rather than a portable domain boundary.
units.keyDataModels: HeartbeatRun, AgentWakeupRequest, Issue, IssueRelation, IssueRecoveryAction, WatchdogDecision, RunEvent, IssueComment metadata, execution policy/state, liveness finding, recovery origin/fingerprint, retry classification, model-profile hint, pause hold and successful-run disposition evidence.
units.lifecycle: Scan persisted work and runs; suppress on active paths/interactions/pause holds/operator cancellation; classify terminal failures; perform bounded retries or provider-quota monitors; upsert source-scoped recovery action; block/escalate with structured comment metadata; wake an Agent owner; separately scan issue-graph dead ends, silent runs and stale locks; retire obsolete recovery issues and clear terminal references. Several updates are transactional or guarded by unique indexes/advisory locks, while many cross-table issue/comment/activity/wake effects remain sequential and only partially idempotent.
units.testAssessment: Six colocated focused tests cover model-profile hint scrubbing, provider error text classification, one-shot review-path recovery with one DB uniqueness matcher, pause retry classification, structured stranded notices, and successful-run missing-disposition handoff including untrusted-text fencing. Major service paths are not covered inside this unit; external recovery/watchdog/stale-lock tests remain separate pending units. Gaps include multilingual/provider-structured failures, crash points across sequential side effects, distributed scheduler races, general wake-key uniqueness, accountable-human owner routing, Connector pause/cancel receipts, permission/data-contract digests and property-based graph recovery.
units.designRationale: Prevent assigned work from silently losing its execution or review path, keep automatic repair bounded, preserve human operator cancellation and pause holds, surface ambiguous success as a missing-disposition incident, and make failure recovery visible rather than leaving live-looking stale rows.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs a canonical Recovery application capability for bounded retry, durable wait, responsibility-aware escalation, crash recovery, stale execution leases, graph dead ends, provider quota and explicit successful-run disposition. It also needs typed recovery causes and receipts across managed-cloud and self-hosted execution nodes.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT the source-scoped recovery action, bounded retry, operator-cancel exemption, pause hold, successful-run disposition, untrusted-evidence fencing, stale-lease compare-and-set, recovery fingerprint/cooldown and explicit observability patterns. Re-express them behind Company OS ports with a durable command/outbox, typed Connector terminal events, exact work/responsibility/data/approval digests, human-first escalation policy and separate RecoveryPolicy, RecoveryProjection and ExecutionLease owners.
units.responsibilityConflict: Recovery owner selection is predominantly Agent reporting chains, creator Agents and hard-coded CTO/CEO roles; board is a fallback value rather than an accountable human principal with authority. Several recoveries reassign and wake Agents without binding the original responsible human or immutable permission/data contract. English error/output classification can change routing meaning, and best-effort/sequential wake/comment/audit writes can leave authority and execution state divergent.
